location: lodging in Eurazania capital; exact inn name UNKNOWN to GM

queen_letter.opening: Прекрасной закрытой двери — от любопытного гения, который не прекращает искать ключи к её замку.
content_summary: Rena explains that she and Arlequino are in Eurazania and that Festival of Eurazania: Week of Strength begins in 30 days and lasts seven days.
Festival and tournament are approved by King Carrion.
Tournament open to locals and foreigners under equal rules, including mass selection, difficult terrain, team-stage against experienced Eurazania beast-army fighters, then individual bouts.
Arlequino intends substantial gold prizes for winner and top participants, exact amounts still TBD.
Winner also gets a separate Crown of Eurazania reward, exact form TBD.
Winner gains official right to challenge Carrion, and Carrion must accept; bout is real, not staged.
Full canonical text of song Герои is attached; Arlequino plans to perform it immediately before Carrion-vs-winner.
Arlequino promises a new song about the eventual winner.
Personal invitation to the Queen to attend festival.
Arlequino's best wishes are to be passed to the King of Blumund.

canon.note: No dispatch has occurred yet; no postage expense yet.

relationship_scene.rena_boundary: earlier pause on renewed sexual escalation still stands; affectionate contact allowed
